title: North Schleswig 1-26 scope audit: Gelsbro marker 26 versus continued Gels Å boundary

historicalSourceRule.pre26: From stone 1, along south Vester Vedsted/Ribe/Seem parish boundaries to stone 22, then east Seem parish boundary to stone 26 at Gjelsbro.
historicalSourceRule.after26: From stone 26 the boundary follows Gels Å to its confluence with Flads Å; following paragraph then leads toward stone 27.

mapObservations.stone26ShownNear: Gjelsbro Zollamt / bridge area, before river meanders northward

provisionalContemporaryBridgeControl.projectedKmMethod: Local planar approximation: longitude × 111320 cos(55.29°) m, latitude ×111195m; bridge represented by average of mapped bridge-way ring. Not a historical stone-26 survey.

requiredRemediation: Mark present 1–26 working master as containing an additional post-26 Gels Å river stretch; do not certify the dataset as stones 1–26 only.
Locate the original 1865 stone-26 near Gjelsbro from contemporaneous cartography/protocol, not from a modern bridge-center guess.
Split at independently verified stone-26 contact with Gels Å; retain entire 26→Flads Å segment as an independent adjoining river-border source.
Review whether the end of the current OSM Gels Å way is the historically specified Flads Å confluence, using an independent river/period map.
Until corrected, preserve current 26.683km master geometry and provisional status without promoting or deleting any point.
